preconditions: projection before communication preserves each row numerical contract
all other value consumers and padding/row order retained
conditional_payload_model.meaning: Conditional interface payload only, not measured network bytes, universal lower bound or10x speedup.

branch_contracts.fact: Reviewed DSA forward zeros the supplied output and returns before Q/KV preparation; no positive projected-KV payload model applies. Outer model collectives and startup ordering remain separate obligations.

branch_contracts.fact: Local query feeds Q and indexer weights; global cache_hidden feeds SWA KV and additionally compressed-source generation iff is_kv_source.

No nonempty global cache payload is modeled; preserve local query, output shape and other branch behavior. No positive gather saving inferred.
